examples.hanzi: 我明年想去越南旅游,听说那里的风景很美。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngnián xiǎng qù Yuènán lǚyóu, tīngshuō nàlǐ de fēngjǐng hěn měi.
examples.english: I want to travel to Vietnam next year; I hear the scenery there is beautiful.

examples.hanzi: 我最喜欢吃越南河粉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan chī Yuènán héfěn.
examples.english: My favorite food is Vietnamese pho.

examples.hanzi: 司机无视红灯,直接开了过去。
examples.pinyin: Sījī wúshì hóngdēng, zhíjiē kāiguòqù le.
examples.english: The driver ignored the red light and drove straight through.

examples.hanzi: 你不能无视别人的感受。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù néng wúshì biéren de gǎnshòu.
examples.english: You can't disregard other people's feelings.

examples.hanzi: 吃了药以后,我感冒慢慢好转了。
examples.pinyin: Chīle yào yǐhòu, wǒ gǎnmào mànmàn hǎozhuǎn le.
examples.english: After taking the medicine, my cold gradually got better.

examples.hanzi: 天气明天会好转,不用太担心。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì míngtiān huì hǎozhuǎn, bú yòng tài dānxīn.
examples.english: The weather will improve tomorrow, so don't worry too much.

examples.hanzi: 这件衣服大小不合适,我想换一件。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu dàxiǎo bù héshì, wǒ xiǎng huàn yí jiàn.
examples.english: This garment isn't the right size, so I'd like to exchange it.

examples.hanzi: 家里大小事情都是妈妈做主。
examples.pinyin: Jiālǐ dàxiǎo shìqing dōu shì māma zuòzhǔ.
examples.english: Mom makes the decisions on all matters in the family, big and small.

examples.hanzi: 他明明很难过,却装作没事的样子。
examples.pinyin: Tā míngmíng hěn nánguò, què zhuāngzuò méishì de yàngzi.
examples.english: He was clearly sad but pretended nothing was wrong.

examples.hanzi: 别装作不懂,我知道你明白。
examples.pinyin: Bié zhuāngzuò bù dǒng, wǒ zhīdào nǐ míngbai.
examples.english: Don't pretend you don't understand; I know you do.

examples.hanzi: 这个游戏有中文版本吗?
examples.pinyin: Zhège yóuxì yǒu Zhōngwén bǎnběn ma?
examples.english: Does this game have a Chinese version?

examples.hanzi: 这本书出了两个版本,内容不太一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū chūle liǎng gè bǎnběn, nèiróng bú tài yíyàng.
examples.english: This book has two editions, and the content differs a bit.

examples.hanzi: 厨房的水管道堵住了,水流不出去。
examples.pinyin: Chúfáng de shuǐ guǎndào dǔzhù le, shuǐ liú bù chūqù.
examples.english: The kitchen's water pipe is blocked, so the water can't drain.

examples.hanzi: 他通过各种管道了解到这个消息。
examples.pinyin: Tā tōngguò gèzhǒng guǎndào liǎojiě dào zhège xiāoxi.
examples.english: He learned this news through various channels.

examples.hanzi: 教堂的屋顶上有一个大十字架。
examples.pinyin: Jiàotáng de wūdǐng shàng yǒu yí gè dà shízìjià.
examples.english: There is a big cross on the church roof.

examples.hanzi: 医院门口的牌子上画着红十字架。
examples.pinyin: Yīyuàn ménkǒu de páizi shàng huàzhe hóng shízìjià.
examples.english: A red cross is painted on the sign at the hospital entrance.

examples.hanzi: 爸爸退休后,我接管了家里的生意。
examples.pinyin: Bàba tuìxiū hòu, wǒ jiēguǎnle jiālǐ de shēngyi.
examples.english: After Dad retired, I took over the family business.

examples.hanzi: 明天开始,由小张接管这个项目。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān kāishǐ, yóu Xiǎo Zhāng jiēguǎn zhège xiàngmù.
examples.english: Starting tomorrow, Xiao Zhang will take over this project.

examples.hanzi: 孩子把玩具扔得乱七八糟。
examples.pinyin: Háizi bǎ wánjù rēng de luànqībāzāo.
examples.english: The child threw the toys all over in a mess.

examples.hanzi: 我的脑子乱七八糟,什么也想不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de nǎozi luànqībāzāo, shénme yě xiǎng bù qīngchu.
examples.english: My head is a muddle and I can't think clearly about anything.

examples.hanzi: 被害人已经被送往医院抢救。
examples.pinyin: Bèihàirén yǐjīng bèi sòngwǎng yīyuàn qiǎngjiù.
examples.english: The victim has been rushed to the hospital for emergency treatment.

examples.hanzi: 被害人向警察描述了当时的情况。
examples.pinyin: Bèihàirén xiàng jǐngchá miáoshùle dāngshí de qíngkuàng.
examples.english: The victim described the situation at the time to the police.

examples.hanzi: 我最近睡眠很缺少,总是觉得累。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn shuìmián hěn quēshǎo, zǒngshì juéde lèi.
examples.english: I've been short on sleep lately and always feel tired.

examples.hanzi: 这道菜缺少一点盐,味道不够好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài quēshǎo yìdiǎn yán, wèidào bú gòu hǎo.
examples.english: This dish lacks a little salt, so it doesn't taste good enough.

examples.hanzi: 我们的校园里有一个很大的湖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de xiàoyuán lǐ yǒu yí gè hěn dà de hú.
examples.english: There's a very big lake on our campus.

examples.hanzi: 他周末常常带女儿到校园里骑车。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhōumò chángcháng dài nǚ'ér dào xiàoyuán lǐ qí chē.
examples.english: On weekends he often takes his daughter cycling around the campus.

examples.hanzi: 这份工作的报酬不高,但很有意义。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò de bàochou bù gāo, dàn hěn yǒu yìyì.
examples.english: The pay for this job isn't high, but it's very meaningful.

examples.hanzi: 他帮了我们很多忙,却不要任何报酬。
examples.pinyin: Tā bāngle wǒmen hěn duō máng, què bú yào rènhé bàochou.
examples.english: He helped us a lot but wouldn't accept any payment.

examples.hanzi: 半夜听到楼上有动静,我吓了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Bànyè tīngdào lóushàng yǒu dòngjing, wǒ xiàle yí tiào.
examples.english: I heard a noise upstairs in the middle of the night and was startled.

examples.hanzi: 对方一直没什么动静,不知道在想什么。
examples.pinyin: Duìfāng yìzhí méi shénme dòngjing, bù zhīdào zài xiǎng shénme.
examples.english: The other side has shown no sign of activity and I don't know what they're thinking.

examples.hanzi: 教室里坐满了认真听课的学生。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshì lǐ zuòmǎnle rènzhēn tīngkè de xuésheng.
examples.english: The classroom was full of students listening attentively.

examples.hanzi: 我的教室在三楼,左边第二间。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de jiàoshì zài sān lóu, zuǒbiān dì èr jiān.
examples.english: My classroom is on the third floor, the second room on the left.

examples.hanzi: 办理手续时,别忘了带身份证件。
examples.pinyin: Bànlǐ shǒuxù shí, bié wàngle dài shēnfèn zhèngjiàn.
examples.english: Don't forget to bring your ID papers when you handle the formalities.

examples.hanzi: 我的证件放在包里,找不到了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de zhèngjiàn fàng zài bāo lǐ, zhǎo bú dào le.
examples.english: My papers were in my bag and I can't find them.

examples.hanzi: 那个犯人被监禁了十年。
examples.pinyin: Nàge fànrén bèi jiānjìnle shí nián.
examples.english: That criminal was imprisoned for ten years.

examples.hanzi: 他不想被监禁在这个小房间里。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng bèi jiānjìn zài zhège xiǎo fángjiān lǐ.
examples.english: He doesn't want to be confined in this small room.

examples.hanzi: 大家热烈欢迎新同学的到来。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā rèliè huānyíng xīn tóngxué de dàolái.
examples.english: Everyone warmly welcomed the arrival of the new classmate.

examples.hanzi: 晚会上的气氛非常热烈。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnhuì shàng de qìfēn fēicháng rèliè.
examples.english: The atmosphere at the evening party was very lively.

examples.hanzi: 会议上,请大家积极发言。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì shàng, qǐng dàjiā jījí fāyán.
examples.english: At the meeting, please all speak up actively.

examples.hanzi: 他在课堂上很少发言,总是静静地听。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài kètáng shàng hěn shǎo fāyán, zǒngshì jìngjìng de tīng.
examples.english: He rarely speaks in class and always listens quietly.

examples.hanzi: 我不是学生,我已经工作了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú shì xuésheng, wǒ yǐjīng gōngzuò le.
examples.english: I'm not a student; I'm already working.

examples.hanzi: 你不是说今天要来吗?怎么还没到?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì shuō jīntiān yào lái ma? Zěnme hái méi dào?
examples.english: Didn't you say you were coming today? Why haven't you arrived yet?

examples.hanzi: 我家后院种了几棵苹果树。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā hòuyuàn zhòngle jǐ kē píngguǒ shù.
examples.english: We planted a few apple trees in our backyard.

examples.hanzi: 周末我们在后院烤肉吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen zài hòuyuàn kǎoròu chī.
examples.english: On weekends we have a barbecue in the backyard.

examples.hanzi: 小孩说谎话时,眼睛不敢看人。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎohái shuō huǎnghuà shí, yǎnjing bù gǎn kàn rén.
examples.english: When children tell lies, they don't dare look people in the eye.

examples.hanzi: 他说的都是谎话,别相信他。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de dōu shì huǎnghuà, bié xiāngxìn tā.
examples.english: Everything he says is a lie, so don't believe him.

examples.hanzi: 无论是大人还是小孩,都喜欢这部动画片。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn shì dàrén háishi xiǎohái, dōu xǐhuan zhè bù dònghuàpiàn.
examples.english: Whether adults or children, everyone likes this cartoon.

examples.hanzi: 无论是现在还是将来,我都会支持你。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn shì xiànzài háishi jiānglái, wǒ dōu huì zhīchí nǐ.
examples.english: Whether now or in the future, I will support you.

examples.hanzi: 小心点,别在湿地板上摔倒了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoxīn diǎn, bié zài shī dìbǎn shàng shuāidǎo le.
examples.english: Be careful not to slip and fall on the wet floor.

examples.hanzi: 他骑车时摔倒了,膝盖受了伤。
examples.pinyin: Tā qí chē shí shuāidǎo le, xīgài shòule shāng.
examples.english: He fell off his bike and hurt his knee.

examples.hanzi: 同学们在课上辩论环保问题。
examples.pinyin: Tóngxuémen zài kè shàng biànlùn huánbǎo wèntí.
examples.english: The students debated environmental issues in class.

examples.hanzi: 我们学校每年都举办辩论比赛。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào měi nián dōu jǔbàn biànlùn bǐsài.
examples.english: Our school holds a debate competition every year.

examples.hanzi: 他心里充满了对敌人的仇恨。
examples.pinyin: Tā xīnlǐ chōngmǎnle duì dírén de chóuhèn.
examples.english: His heart was filled with hatred for the enemy.

examples.hanzi: 仇恨只会带来更多的痛苦。
examples.pinyin: Chóuhèn zhǐ huì dàilái gèng duō de tòngkǔ.
examples.english: Hatred only brings more pain.

examples.hanzi: 你能帮我看看这段代码哪里错了吗?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng bāng wǒ kànkan zhè duàn dàimǎ nǎlǐ cuò le ma?
examples.english: Can you help me see what's wrong with this piece of code?

examples.hanzi: 他每天晚上都写代码到很晚。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān wǎnshang dōu xiě dàimǎ dào hěn wǎn.
examples.english: He writes code late into the night every day.

examples.hanzi: 我们要节约能源,少开空调。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào jiéyuē néngyuán, shǎo kāi kōngtiáo.
examples.english: We should save energy and use the air conditioning less.

examples.hanzi: 这个国家的能源主要来自水力。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā de néngyuán zhǔyào láizì shuǐlì.
examples.english: This country's energy mainly comes from hydropower.

examples.hanzi: 大使在欢迎晚宴上发表了讲话。
examples.pinyin: Dàshǐ zài huānyíng wǎnyàn shàng fābiǎole jiǎnghuà.
examples.english: The ambassador gave a speech at the welcome dinner.

examples.hanzi: 中国驻法国大使今天见了记者。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó zhù Fǎguó dàshǐ jīntiān jiànle jìzhě.
examples.english: The Chinese ambassador to France met reporters today.

examples.hanzi: 我想从动物收容所领养一只猫。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng cóng dòngwù shōuróngsuǒ lǐngyǎng yì zhī māo.
examples.english: I'd like to adopt a cat from the animal shelter.

examples.hanzi: 这对夫妻领养了一个小女孩。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duì fūqī lǐngyǎngle yí gè xiǎo nǚhái.
examples.english: This couple adopted a little girl.

examples.hanzi: 下课后,同学们聚集在操场上。
examples.pinyin: Xiàkè hòu, tóngxuémen jùjí zài cāochǎng shàng.
examples.english: After class, the students gathered on the playground.

examples.hanzi: 很多鸟聚集在湖边找东西吃。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niǎo jùjí zài húbiān zhǎo dōngxi chī.
examples.english: Many birds gather by the lake to look for food.

examples.hanzi: 我们周末去布鲁克林看了一场球赛。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōumò qù Bùlǔkèlín kànle yì chǎng qiúsài.
examples.english: We went to Brooklyn at the weekend to watch a ball game.

examples.hanzi: 他住在纽约的布鲁克林,离地铁站很近。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhù zài Niǔyuē de Bùlǔkèlín, lí dìtiězhàn hěn jìn.
examples.english: He lives in Brooklyn, New York, very close to a subway station.

examples.hanzi: 我今天胃口很好,吃了三碗饭。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān wèikǒu hěn hǎo, chīle sān wǎn fàn.
examples.english: I have a good appetite today and ate three bowls of rice.

examples.hanzi: 这道菜很对我的胃口。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài hěn duì wǒ de wèikǒu.
examples.english: This dish is just to my taste.

examples.hanzi: 周二下午我有空,我们见面吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu'èr xiàwǔ wǒ yǒu kòng, wǒmen jiànmiàn ba.
examples.english: I'm free on Tuesday afternoon, so let's meet.

examples.hanzi: 我每周二晚上都去游泳。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi zhōu'èr wǎnshang dōu qù yóuyǒng.
examples.english: I go swimming every Tuesday evening.

examples.hanzi: 这些旧邮票其实很值钱。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē jiù yóupiào qíshí hěn zhíqián.
examples.english: These old stamps are actually worth a lot.

examples.hanzi: 你包里有什么值钱的东西吗?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bāo lǐ yǒu shénme zhíqián de dōngxi ma?
examples.english: Do you have anything valuable in your bag?

examples.hanzi: 古时候,犯了罪的人常被流放到很远的地方。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ shíhou, fànle zuì de rén cháng bèi liúfàng dào hěn yuǎn de dìfang.
examples.english: In ancient times, criminals were often exiled to faraway places.

examples.hanzi: 他在国外流放了十几年,才回到家乡。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài guówài liúfàngle shí jǐ nián, cái huídào jiāxiāng.
examples.english: He lived in exile abroad for more than ten years before returning home.

examples.hanzi: 我这样说,都是为你着想。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhèyàng shuō, dōu shì wèi nǐ zhuóxiǎng.
examples.english: I'm saying this for your own good.

examples.hanzi: 做事要多为别人着想。
examples.pinyin: Zuòshì yào duō wèi biéren zhuóxiǎng.
examples.english: When you do things, think more about others.

examples.hanzi: 他因为生病丧失了工作能力。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi shēngbìng sàngshīle gōngzuò nénglì.
examples.english: He lost his ability to work because of illness.

examples.hanzi: 遇到困难,不要丧失信心。
examples.pinyin: Yùdào kùnnan, bú yào sàngshī xìnxīn.
examples.english: When you face difficulties, don't lose confidence.

examples.hanzi: 爷爷以前每天抽一根雪茄。
examples.pinyin: Yéye yǐqián měitiān chōu yì gēn xuějiā.
examples.english: Grandpa used to smoke a cigar every day.

examples.hanzi: 这盒雪茄是朋友从古巴带来的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè hé xuějiā shì péngyou cóng Gǔbā dàilái de.
examples.english: This box of cigars was brought from Cuba by a friend.

examples.hanzi: 今天有点冷,你多穿一件上衣吧。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān yǒudiǎn lěng, nǐ duō chuān yí jiàn shàngyī ba.
examples.english: It's a bit cold today, so wear an extra top.

examples.hanzi: 这套衣服的上衣太大了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào yīfu de shàngyī tài dà le.
examples.english: The top of this outfit is too big.

examples.hanzi: 人性有善的一面,也有恶的一面。
examples.pinyin: Rénxìng yǒu shàn de yímiàn, yě yǒu è de yímiàn.
examples.english: Human nature has a good side and a bad side.

examples.hanzi: 这样的管理方式太不人性了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng de guǎnlǐ fāngshì tài bù rénxìng le.
examples.english: This way of managing is far too inhumane.

examples.hanzi: 你说话别这么粗鲁,要有礼貌。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuōhuà bié zhème cūlǔ, yào yǒu lǐmào.
examples.english: Don't speak so rudely; be polite.

examples.hanzi: 那个司机的动作很粗鲁,吓到了乘客。
examples.pinyin: Nàge sījī de dòngzuò hěn cūlǔ, xiàdàole chéngkè.
examples.english: That driver's movements were rough and frightened the passengers.

examples.hanzi: 他十八岁就离家去了北京。
examples.pinyin: Tā shíbā suì jiù líjiā qùle Běijīng.
examples.english: He left home for Beijing at eighteen.

examples.hanzi: 离家这么久,我特别想妈妈做的菜。
examples.pinyin: Líjiā zhème jiǔ, wǒ tèbié xiǎng māma zuò de cài.
examples.english: After being away from home so long, I really miss Mom's cooking.

examples.hanzi: 闹钟响了,你快把弟弟叫醒。
examples.pinyin: Nàozhōng xiǎng le, nǐ kuài bǎ dìdi jiàoxǐng.
examples.english: The alarm has gone off, so go wake up your younger brother.

examples.hanzi: 一阵雷声把我从梦里叫醒了。
examples.pinyin: Yí zhèn léishēng bǎ wǒ cóng mèng lǐ jiàoxǐng le.
examples.english: A peal of thunder woke me from my dream.

examples.hanzi: 这场电影的开场很吸引人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng diànyǐng de kāichǎng hěn xīyǐn rén.
examples.english: The opening of this movie is very engaging.

examples.hanzi: 演唱会晚上七点开场,别迟到。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnchànghuì wǎnshang qī diǎn kāichǎng, bié chídào.
examples.english: The concert starts at seven in the evening, so don't be late.

examples.hanzi: 手机的辐射对身体影响不大。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī de fúshè duì shēntǐ yǐngxiǎng bú dà.
examples.english: Phone radiation has little effect on the body.

examples.hanzi: 太阳光向四周辐射热量。
examples.pinyin: Tàiyángguāng xiàng sìzhōu fúshè rèliàng.
examples.english: Sunlight radiates heat in all directions.

examples.hanzi: 我的钱包不知下落,可能丢在出租车上了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo bù zhī xiàluò, kěnéng diū zài chūzūchē shàng le.
examples.english: I don't know where my wallet is; maybe I left it in the taxi.

examples.hanzi: 飞机的高度在快速下落。
examples.pinyin: Fēijī de gāodù zài kuàisù xiàluò.
examples.english: The plane's altitude is dropping rapidly.

examples.hanzi: 他在班上的成绩一直落后,很着急。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bān shàng de chéngjì yìzhí luòhòu, hěn zháojí.
examples.english: His grades in class have always lagged behind, and he's anxious.

examples.hanzi: 我们的技术还落后别人一大截。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de jìshù hái luòhòu biéren yí dà jié.
examples.english: Our technology is still far behind others.

examples.hanzi: 老师带领同学们唱起了校歌。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī dàilǐng tóngxuémen chàngqǐle xiàogē.
examples.english: The teacher led the students in singing the school song.

examples.hanzi: 他带领团队完成了这个重要的项目。
examples.pinyin: Tā dàilǐng tuánduì wánchéngle zhège zhòngyào de xiàngmù.
examples.english: He led the team to complete this important project.
